lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters. The centroids form vertical columns in the anterior-mid section of the visible flank, with horizontal spacing between columns being approximately 1.5 times the vertical spacing between blobs within a column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, acting as anchor nodes for the vertical column alignment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, thin, horizontal high-intensity white line is visible extending from the trailing edge/tip of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Transition from a sparse, large-blob pattern on the upper flank to a high-density, small-blob texture on the pectoral fin surface.
